headline: Sensex and Nifty Rebound as Metal Stocks Rally and Crude Oil Prices Ease

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Easing crude oil prices boosted market sentiment and helped indices recover
Hopes of de-escalation in West Asia provided relief to global and domestic markets
A strong rally in metal and realty sectors led the market rebound
Positive cues from Asian markets like Kospi and Taiwan signaled a recovery
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty recovered after six consecutive weekly falls, with Nifty closing above 23,400
NSE shares are set to trade on the Metropolitan Stock Exchange in addition to the BSE
Fujifilm India is exploring deals to supply chemicals to domestic semiconductor companies
The RBI has given in-principle approval to Samvriddhi Inclusive Growth Network to operate as an online payment aggregator
summary: Indian markets staged a recovery as the Sensex and Nifty rebounded from recent lows, supported by a rally in metal stocks and falling crude oil prices. Bajaj Finance and Hindalco emerged as top gainers while investors monitored easing tensions in West Asia. Additionally, regulatory developments saw the RBI granting payment aggregator nods and the expansion of NSE share trading to the Metropolitan Stock Exchange.
